titulo: The imperfect to refer to a present or future action
regla: The imperfect can talk about now or later when you pass on information you heard or planned (Alberto tenía partido = he has a game, as far as I know), and to sound polite: ¿Qué quería? / Quería pedirte un favor.

lista.texto: **Alberto tenía partido hoy**: _as far as I was told, he has a game_. It softens your responsibility for the info.
**Elena llegaba esta noche, ¿no?** (_Elena's arriving tonight, right? that was the plan_)
**Quería pedirte un favor.** **¿Qué deseaba?** (shop clerk) **Venía a preguntar...**

bloques.texto: The polite imperfect is everyday in Mexico: **¿Qué quería, güera?** at the market.
Tip: the imperfect steps one step back so it sounds less blunt.

lista.es: —Qué raro, Alberto no está. —No, Alberto ==tenía== un partido de rugby, ¿no te dijo ayer?
lista.en: —Weird, Alberto isn't home. —No, Alberto has a rugby game, didn't he tell you yesterday?

lista.es: Elena ==llegaba== esta noche, ¿verdad? Su vuelo aterriza a las diez.
lista.en: Elena's arriving tonight, right? Her flight lands at ten.
I wanted to ask you a favor.
Good afternoon, what would you like?

lista.es: ==Venía== a preguntar por el departamento en renta.
lista.en: I've come to ask about the apartment for rent.

lista.nota: Both fine; the imperfect is softer.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Politely: _I wanted to ask you something._
Reported plan: _The game was tonight, wasn't it?_ (it's still on)
lista.r: El partido era hoy en la noche, ¿no?
